actions_or_findings.title: ANN007-B2 [CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER] Management list can permanently hide announcements
actions_or_findings.trigger: The first 50 rows include tenant-wide announcements anchored to another property, or a property accumulates more than 50 announcements.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Impact: filtering occurs after the SQL limit, and the API derives next_cursor from the filtered count. Evidence: repository lines 573–589; service lines 515–525; admin_announcements.py lines 100–113; miniprogram/pages/supervisor/announcements.js lines 97–123.

actions_or_findings.title: ANN007-B3 [CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER] Page publish controls use permissions from other scopes
actions_or_findings.trigger: One user has publish permission for property A and draft-only permission for property B, then opens property B's announcement page.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Impact: the page shows approval controls for B because canPublish reads the union in me.permissions; the API correctly rejects the action. canTenant likewise checks for any tenant grant without matching the selected property's tenant. This fails the requested role-capability page behavior. Evidence: page lines 102–113 and 247–260; backend/app/domain/iam.py lines 70–90.
